an3.105:1.1: 106 no cetaṃ bhikkhave loke assādo abhavissa nayidaṃ sattā loke sārajjeyyuṃ
an3.105:1.2: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi loke assādo tasmā sattā loke sārajjanti.
an3.105:1.3: no cetaṃ bhikkhave loke ādīnavo abhavissa nayidaṃ sattā loke nibbindeyyuṃ
an3.105:1.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi loke ādīnavo tasmā sattā loke nibbindanti.
an3.105:1.5: no cetaṃ bhikkhave loke nissaraṇaṃ abhavissa nayidaṃ sattā lokamhā nissareyyuṃ
an3.105:1.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi loke nissaraṇaṃ tasmā sattā lokamhā nissaranti.
an3.105:1.7: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave sattā lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsaṃ nevatāva bhikkhave sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaṃyuttā vippamuttā vimariyādīkatena cetasā vihariṃsu.
an3.105:1.8: yato ca kho bhikkhave sattā lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsaṃ atha bhikkhave sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaṃyuttā vippamuttā vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharantīti.
